warning.titlePre: Jaguar F-Type R Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The AJ133 is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ133 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.
Because the F-Type R uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the F-Type 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established AJ133 specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
